items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Chester Jones, he's the only one who can do it with me now since my brother gone.

ctx.x: Well, how did you teach him? I know you do those drum solos. Yeah. Who do you do it with now? You do it, Chester Jones?
Well, Chester Jones, he's the only one who can do it with me now since my brother gone. I've tried with them other fellas, you know, but they can't, I don't know, they're just all the same.
You were doing it a little bit the other day.
